## Verdict

**PASS** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` — the contract increment is correctly bounded, the changeset tier matches, every cancel point and the non-TTY path behave as the card's ruled direction (i) requires, and the CLI-level tests pin the contract with a genuine control. Findings below are non-blocking notes for the ACCEPT comment; none warrants REWORK.

## Head reviewed

`4ae7e7c6f71aea9089e1becda21e1d5b9c13468d` — matches the requested prefix; head did not move. Branch `claude/issue-8786-create-plugin-cancel-and-nontty`, 1 commit over merge-base `4e3a4f07e`, base `main`, draft, `mergeable_state: clean`. 5 files, +495/−37.

## Clause-② reading, claim match, `--pair`

- **My reading: `yes`** (behaviour limb). No new exported symbol (`@object-ui/create-plugin` is `bin`-only, no `exports`), no new key on a published payload. What changes is the published behaviour of the `create-plugin` binary on runs a user can perform: cancel at `Plugin description:`/`Author name:` goes from `TypeError`+exit 1+empty dir → 10 files+exit 0; `< /dev/null` goes from nothing-written+exit 0 → 10 files+exit 0; nameless non-TTY goes from silent exit 0 → `Plugin name is required` exit 1. `README.md` is in `files[]` (published) and gains a section. `yes` is the conservative and correct call.
- **Claim:** card claim comment 5607811424 carries `Clause-②: yes` in the fixed spelling (dev-appended under PM pre-authorisation, no second claim); PR body says the same in prose. **Match.**
- **`PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 8893` → exit 0** ("readable in the fixed spelling and both carriers agree"); `needs:contract-review` on both carriers.

## Governed surface

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test <5 paths>` → **NOT GOVERNED**, exit 0. No `content/docs/releases/` touched. Normal merge-queue route.

## CI on head

33 check-runs on `4ae7e7c6f`: 30 `success`, 3 `skipped` (coverage lanes + dependabot — push-only). `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Test (shard 1–4/4)`, `Build & E2E`, `Changeset Declaration/Bump Policy/Fixed Group`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all green. Nothing red ⇒ no causation analysis owed. The new test cannot pass vacuously (build failure or missing `script(1)` throws/rejects), so shard green is evidence it ran.

## Findings

**F1 — Published-face delta (all `packages/create-plugin/src/index.ts` at head).**
- `:53-55` `hasInteractiveStdin()` (internal, `process.stdin.isTTY === true`), evaluated once at `:60`.
- `:66-89` name prompt only when interactive; `:96-99` a nameless non-TTY run or a cancel at the name prompt now reaches the existing `Plugin name is required` / `exit(1)` (previously non-TTY hung `prompts` and fell off the event loop with exit 0, nothing printed).
- `:127-128` defaults written once; `:157-166` `prompts` only called when interactive, `onCancel` records and returns `undefined` (keeps `prompts`' abort-remaining, return-partial semantics); `:193-194` `?? initial` merge — the `TypeError` site. `PluginAnswers` (`:35-39`) makes raw reads a `TS2322`, as the ablation A1a confirms.
- `:168-172` two new stdout lines (`No TTY on stdin — …`, `Cancelled — …`) — informational output, asserted by tests as substrings, so they are now pinned text.
- `:210` `buildPluginFiles(vars)` before `:217` `fs.mkdirpSync` — no directory exists until every file's contents exists.
- Exit-code set unchanged `{0,1}`; the mapping changes only on the three runs listed under Clause-②. Files on cancel: 10 at Description/Author/License, 0 at name.
- `README.md:69-91` new section; `content/docs/utilities/create-plugin.mdx:57-63` new paragraph. The pre-existing `README.md:66-67` sentence is now true instead of false.

**F2 — Correctness vs the card: every cancel point, verified against the diff.**
- Name prompt (interactive Ctrl-C): `prompts` returns `{}` → `:96-99` exit 1, nothing created — pre-existing, unchanged, now documented.
- Description cancel → `answers = {}` → both text defaults + MIT; Author cancel → `{description}` → author `''` → holder falls to "the … authors"; License cancel → `{description, author}` → MIT via `resolveLicenseId(undefined)`. All three write 10 files, exit 0.
- Non-TTY: `{}` → all defaults; `--author`/`--description` become the written values (`:127-128`).
- Directory-exists check (`:176-180`) still precedes any write; with templating hoisted, no path can leave a half-created directory before the write loop. (The write loop `:218-222` itself is still non-atomic against an I/O failure mid-loop — out of this card's scope; the card's defect was pre-write.)
- Piped stdin *with content* is now silently ignored in favour of defaults; before the PR it wrote nothing. Not a regression, documented in the README ("a pipe … Nothing is asked"), and the `No TTY on stdin` line makes it visible.

**F3 — Scope: clean.** 5 files, all inside `packages/create-plugin` + its doc page + one changeset. Card item 4 (optional `templates.ts` docblock) correctly not carried: this diff touches neither `buildPackageJson` nor `buildLicenseFile`, so it does not falsify the docblock; filed as objectui#8892. No line-citation (class A) moved: `git grep 'index\.ts:[0-9]+'` over the package and the doc page finds none on `origin/main`.

**F4 — Changeset: correct.** `@object-ui/create-plugin: minor` — the card's own rule (non-TTY default path added ⇒ `minor`, never `major`); package is public. Text matches measured behaviour. Pending `.changeset/8041-…` needs no correction — its sentence becomes true with this PR.

**F5 — Tests pin the contract with a real control.** `src/__tests__/cli-cancel-and-nontty-8786.test.ts` drives the *built bin* (rebuilt unconditionally in `beforeAll`, `VITEST` scrubbed per #8598 — same pattern as `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts`): asserts exit code, the exact 10-file set, `manifest.license`, LICENSE holder, and the no-`TypeError` stderr on each of Description/Author cancels; the License cancel is the ⭐ control (green before and after — confirmed by the PR's A1b/A2 ablation table, where it stays green in both legs); nameless non-TTY asserts exit 1 and `files === null`. Two gaps, both minor:
  - (a) **Interactive cancel at the name prompt** (README:80-83 promises exit 1, nothing created) is not pinned — only the non-TTY nameless case is. Suggest a follow-up case; not a REWORK item since the behaviour is unchanged and README-stated.
  - (b) **`script -qec … /dev/null` is util-linux syntax**; BSD/macOS `script` lacks `-e`/`-c`, so the four pty cases fail off-Linux with no platform guard, and this is the first pty-driven test in the tree (no `spawn('script')` precedent). CI is `ubuntu-latest`, so this is a contributor-ergonomics note, not a gate. Also note `stdin.end()` right after the last step makes util-linux `script` inject a VEOF (Ctrl-D) into the pty after the slave drains — benign here because every step list ends the last live prompt, but worth a one-line comment if the harness is reused.

**F6 — README/docs: consistent with behaviour.** README section and mdx paragraph state one rule and the single name exception, matching `index.ts`. One adjacent pre-existing defect: `create-plugin.mdx:52-53` still says "Everything else — a description and an author — is asked interactively", omitting the licence prompt #8041 added; the dev flagged it as "noted, not filed". Per the checklist (noticed-but-untouched published defect ⇒ file a card), this should become a card at ACCEPT rather than a note; not this PR's falsification.

**F7 — PR form.** `Fixes #8786` is correct: card items 1–3 are fully met and item 4 is filed as #8892; no other closing keyword sits beside an open card number (the word "closes" at the docblock quote is followed by prose, not a reference). Body carries the duplicated bare attribution footer the dev already reported — cosmetic.
